source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 白海豚或携极端暴雨重创东部多省市
topics.official_english: Typhoon Baijud may bring extreme rain and severe damage to multiple eastern provinces and cities.
topics.why_hot: A powerful typhoon is being closely watched in eastern China, where forecasts of extreme rain have raised public concern.
topics.share_angle: Explain the track and warnings for Typhoon Baijud, and tell viewers how to follow official updates.

topics.official_english: A low-priced ticket promotion reportedly drives 7.6 billion yuan in consumer spending.
topics.why_hot: A discount ticket promotion has reportedly sparked billions of yuan in spending, making it a vivid example of tourism's economic pull.
topics.share_angle: Break down the numbers and discuss how low-cost tickets can boost local tourism and consumption.

topics.chinese_topic: 微信新功能：你可以“撤回”你的撤回
topics.official_english: WeChat adds a feature that lets you undo a message recall.
topics.why_hot: Users are curious and amused by WeChat's new ability to undo a recalled message.
topics.share_angle: Show how the new WeChat feature works and what it means for everyday chat etiquette.

topics.chinese_topic: 一些民办高校招不到学生了
topics.official_english: Some private colleges are struggling to attract students.
topics.why_hot: Enrollment pressure on private colleges touches on a major shift in Chinese higher education and demographics.
topics.share_angle: Examine why some private universities are reportedly struggling and what it says about the sector's future.

topics.chinese_topic: “新疆阿勒泰八月能滑雪”不实
topics.official_english: Claims that Altay in Xinjiang can offer skiing in August are untrue.
topics.why_hot: A viral claim about skiing in Altay in August has been challenged, prompting online fact-checking.
topics.share_angle: Use the claim as a case study for why travel-season rumors spread and how to verify them.

topics.official_english: China's 'vegetable hometown' records a high of 41.8 C.
topics.why_hot: Extreme heat in a major vegetable-producing area draws attention to climate impacts on agriculture and daily life.
topics.share_angle: Explain how record heat in the vegetable hometown could affect supply chains and farmers.

topics.chinese_topic: 女子被狗舔脚确诊三级暴露 医生回应
topics.official_english: Doctor responds after woman confirmed with Grade III rabies exposure from dog licking her foot.
topics.why_hot: A report about a woman needing rabies-wound care after a dog licked her foot has gone viral, mixed with questions and reassurance.
topics.share_angle: Share expert explanations of rabies exposure levels and what dog-licking wounds actually mean.

topics.chinese_topic: 男演员入职景区：比做演员更有安全感
topics.official_english: Actor takes a job at a scenic spot, saying it gives more security than acting.
topics.why_hot: An actor who found stable work at a tourist site resonates with public discussion about career security.
topics.share_angle: Frame it as a human-interest story about changing career expectations, not celebrity gossip.
